title: Carry out animal research only as a licensed institution
what: Carry out animal research only through an institution licensed for it, and within its licence.

sources.title: Animal Welfare Act 1993 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not carry out animal research unless it is carried out – (a) by an institution licensed under this Part; and (b) in accordance with the licence issued, under this Part, to the institution
